units.zh: 「大司馬臣去病昧死再拜上疏皇帝陛下：陛下過聽，使臣去病待罪行閒。
units.en: "Your servant, the Grand Marshal Qubing, at the risk of death bows twice and submits this memorial to His Imperial Majesty: Your Majesty has shown me far too much favor, allowing your servant Qubing to hold an undeserved position among the ranks of honor.
units.literal: 'Grand Marshal subject Qubing, risking death, bows twice and submits memorial to Emperor Your Majesty: Your Majesty has favored me excessively, allowing subject Qubing to await punishment in the ranks of the honored.

units.zh: 宜專邊塞之思慮，暴骸中野無以報，乃敢惟他議以干用事者，誠見陛下憂勞天下，哀憐百姓以自忘，虧膳貶樂，損郎員。
units.en: By rights, I ought to devote all my thoughts to the frontier, and even if I left my bones bleaching in the wilderness I could never repay Your Majesty's grace. Yet I dare raise another matter and trouble those who conduct affairs of state, for I have truly witnessed Your Majesty toiling on behalf of the realm, pitying the common people until you forget your own well-being, cutting your meals, forgoing your pleasures, and reducing the number of court attendants.
units.literal: I should focus my thoughts solely on border defenses, yet even exposing my bones in the wilderness cannot repay, yet I dare contemplate other matters to interfere with those handling affairs, sincerely seeing Your Majesty toil for the world, pity the people to the point of forgetting yourself, reducing meals and diminishing pleasures, cutting the number of attendants.

units.zh: 皇子賴天，能勝衣趨拜，至今無號位師傅官。
units.en: The imperial princes, blessed by Heaven, have grown old enough to dress in formal robes and perform court obeisances, yet to this day they have received no royal titles, no official positions, and no appointed tutors.
units.literal: The imperial sons rely on heaven, able to dress and make formal bows, yet to this day have no titles, positions, tutors, or officials.

units.zh: 陛下恭讓不恤，群臣私望，不敢越職而言。
units.en: Your Majesty, out of modesty, has not attended to this matter. The ministers all harbor private hopes regarding it, yet none dares overstep his office to speak.
units.literal: Your Majesty is respectfully modest and does not worry, the ministers privately hope, but dare not speak beyond their duties.

units.zh: 臣竊不勝犬馬心，昧死願陛下詔有司，因盛夏吉時定皇子位。
units.en: Your servant, unable to restrain his humble devotion, at the risk of death begs Your Majesty to command the proper officials to take advantage of this auspicious midsummer season to establish the imperial princes in their rightful positions.
units.literal: Your servant secretly cannot contain his dog-and-horse heart, risking death wishes Your Majesty to command the officials, taking advantage of the auspicious summer season to establish the imperial sons' positions.

units.zh: 唯陛下幸察。
units.en: I humbly beg Your Majesty to consider this petition.
units.literal: Only may Your Majesty be so gracious as to examine this.

units.zh: 臣去病昧死再拜以聞皇帝陛下。」
units.en: Your servant Qubing, at the risk of death, bows twice to bring this to His Imperial Majesty's attention."
units.literal: Subject Qubing risks death, bows twice, to inform Emperor Your Majesty.'

units.zh: 三月乙亥，御史臣光守尚書令奏未央宮。
units.en: On the yihai day of the third month, the Imperial Censor Guang, serving as Prefect of the Imperial Secretariat, presented the memorial at Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: Third month, day yi-hai, Censor subject Guang acting as Minister of the Imperial Secretariat memorialized at Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 制曰：「下御史。」
units.en: The imperial edict read: "Forward this to the Imperial Censor."
units.literal: Imperial command: 'Send to the Censor.'

units.zh: 六年三月戊申朔，乙亥，御史臣光守尚書令、丞非，下御史書到，言：丞相臣青翟、御史大夫臣湯、太常臣充、大行令臣息、太子少傅臣安行宗正事昧死上言：大司馬去病上疏曰：『陛下過聽，使臣去病待罪行閒。
units.en: In the sixth year, third month, on the wushen day which was the first of the month, and on the yihai day, the Imperial Censor Guang, serving as Prefect of the Imperial Secretariat, together with his Aide Fei, transmitted the document and reported: The Chancellor Qing Di, the Grandee Secretary Tang, the Grand Master of Ceremonies Chong, the Grand Herald Xi, and the Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince An, acting as Director of the Imperial Clan, at the risk of death submit the following: The Grand Marshal Qubing has presented a memorial stating: 'Your Majesty has shown me far too much favor, allowing your servant Qubing to hold an undeserved position among the ranks of honor.
units.literal: In the third month of year 6, day wu-shen first day, day yi-hai, Censor subject Guang acting as Minister of the Imperial Secretariat and Aide Fei, sent the censor memorial, saying: Chancellor subject Qing Di, Censor-in-Chief subject Tang, Grand Master of Ceremonies subject Chong, Grand Herald subject Xi, Crown Prince Junior Tutor subject An acting as Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan, risking death submit: Grand Marshal Qubing submitted memorial saying: 'Your Majesty has favored me excessively, allowing subject Qubing to await punishment in the ranks of the honored.

units.zh: 臣謹與中二千石、二千石臣賀等議：古者裂地立國，并建諸侯以承天于，所以尊宗廟重社稷也。
units.en: We, your servants, have respectfully deliberated with the officials of the central two-thousand-shi and two-thousand-shi ranks, including He and others, and submit the following: In ancient times territory was divided and states were established, and feudal lords were invested to uphold the Son of Heaven, thereby honoring the ancestral temples and safeguarding the altars of soil and grain.
units.literal: Subjects respectfully with the central two thousand shi and two thousand shi subject He and others discuss: In ancient times, territory was divided to establish states, establishing feudal lords together to receive heaven's mandate, thus to honor the ancestral temple and weight the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 今臣去病上疏，不忘其職，因以宣恩，乃道天子卑讓自貶以勞天下，慮皇子未有號位。
units.en: Now the Grand Marshal Qubing has submitted his memorial, not forgetting his duty, thereby proclaiming imperial benevolence. He has spoken of how the Son of Heaven humbly defers and effaces himself while laboring for the realm, and how he is concerned that the imperial princes have not yet been granted titles.
units.literal: Now subject Qubing submits memorial, does not forget his duty, thus proclaims benevolence, moreover states the Son of Heaven's humble yielding and self-deprecation to labor for the world, concerned the imperial sons have no titles.

units.zh: 臣青翟、臣湯等宜奉義遵職，愚憧而不逮事。
units.en: We, your servants Qing Di, Tang, and the others, should have upheld righteousness and fulfilled our duties, but in our foolishness and dullness we have failed to attend to this matter.
units.literal: Subjects Qing Di, Tang and others should uphold righteousness and follow duty, foolishly dull and not up to affairs.

units.zh: 方今盛夏吉時，臣青翟、臣湯等昧死請立皇子臣閎、臣旦、臣胥為諸侯王。
units.en: Now, at this auspicious season of midsummer, we, your servants Qing Di, Tang, and the others, at the risk of death request that the imperial princes Hong, Dan, and Xu be established as feudal kings.
units.literal: Now is the auspicious summer season, subjects Qing Que, Tang and others risking death request to establish imperial sons subject Hong, subject Dan, subject Xu as feudal kings.

units.zh: 昧死請所立國名。
units.en: At the risk of death, I ask what names should be given to the states that are to be established.
units.literal: Risking death request the names of the states to establish.

units.zh: 制曰：「蓋聞周封八百，姬姓并列，或子、男、附庸。
units.en: The imperial edict read: "I have heard that the Zhou dynasty enfeoffed eight hundred lords, and those of the Ji surname were ranked among them—some as viscounts, some as barons, and some as mere dependencies.
units.literal: Imperial command: 'I have heard that Zhou enfeoffed eight hundred, the Ji surname stood together, some were viscounts, barons, or dependencies.

units.zh: 禮『支子不祭』。
units.en: The Rites state that 'cadet sons do not perform ancestral sacrifices.'
units.literal: The rites say 'branch sons do not sacrifice'.

units.zh: 云并建諸侯所以重社稷，朕無聞焉。
units.en: As for the claim that establishing feudal lords safeguards the altars of soil and grain—I have never heard such a thing.
units.literal: Saying establishing feudal lords together is to weight the altars of soil and grain, I have not heard this.

units.zh: 且天非為君生民也。
units.en: Moreover, Heaven does not bring the people into being for the ruler's sake.
units.literal: Moreover, heaven does not give birth to the people for the ruler's sake.

units.zh: 朕之不德，海內未洽，乃以未教成者彊君連城，即股肱何勸？
units.en: Given my lack of virtue and the fact that the realm is not yet at peace, to force those who have not yet completed their education to rule over strings of cities—how would that motivate my ministers?
units.literal: My lack of virtue, the realm within the seas is not yet harmonious, yet to force those not yet educated to rule connected cities, then what encouragement for the limbs and bones?

units.zh: 其更議以列侯家之。」
units.en: Let the ministers deliberate again and propose instead to establish them as marquises."
units.literal: Have them discuss again to establish them as marquises.'

units.zh: 三月丙子，奏未央宮。
units.en: On the bingzi day of the third month, a memorial was presented at Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: Third month, day bing-zi, memorialized at Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 「丞相臣青翟、御史大夫臣湯昧死言：臣謹與列侯臣嬰齊、中二千石二千石臣賀、諫大夫博士臣安等議曰：伏聞周封八百，姬姓并列，奉承天子。
units.en: "The Chancellor Qing Di and the Grandee Secretary Tang, at the risk of death, state: We, your servants, have respectfully deliberated with the Marquis Ying Qi, the officials of two-thousand-shi and central two-thousand-shi rank including He, and the Remonstrant Official and Erudite An, among others, and submit the following: We have heard that the Zhou dynasty enfeoffed eight hundred lords, and those of the Ji surname were ranged alongside them, all serving and upholding the Son of Heaven.
units.literal: 'Chancellor subject Qing Di, Censor-in-Chief subject Tang risking death speak: Subjects respectfully with Marquis subject Ying Qi, central two thousand shi and two thousand shi subject He, Remonstrance Official and Erudite subject An and others discuss: We have heard that Zhou enfeoffed eight hundred, the Ji surname stood together, supporting the Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 康叔以祖考顯，而伯禽以周公立，咸為建國諸侯，以相傅為輔。
units.en: Kang Shu rose to prominence through his forebears, while Bo Qin was established by the Duke of Zhou; both became feudal lords of established states, serving as supports and pillars of the dynasty.
units.literal: Kang Shu attained prominence through his ancestors, while Bo Qin was established by the Duke of Zhou, both became feudal lords of states, to mutually assist as help.

units.zh: 百官奉憲，各遵其職，而國統備矣。
units.en: All the officials upheld the laws and each fulfilled his duties, and thus the governance of the state was made complete.
units.literal: The hundred officials uphold the constitution, each follows their duty, and the state system is complete.

units.zh: 竊以為并建諸侯所以重社稷者，四海諸侯各以其職奉貢祭。
units.en: We humbly believe that the reason establishing feudal lords safeguards the altars of soil and grain is that the lords of the four seas each fulfill their duties and present tribute and sacrifices.
units.literal: We secretly consider that establishing feudal lords together to weight the altars of soil and grain means the feudal lords of the four seas each offer tribute and sacrifices according to their duties.

units.zh: 支子不得奉祭宗祖，禮也。
units.en: That cadet sons may not perform sacrifices to the ancestral temples is prescribed by ritual.
units.literal: Branch sons may not offer sacrifices to the ancestral temple, this is ritual.

units.zh: 封建使守藩國，帝王所以扶德施化。
units.en: The investiture of feudal lords to guard the border states is the means by which emperors and kings sustain virtue and spread civilization.
units.literal: Feudalism causes them to guard the border states, this is how emperors support virtue and spread civilization.

units.zh: 陛下奉承天統，明開聖緒，尊賢顯功，興滅繼絕。
units.en: Your Majesty carries on Heaven's mandate, brilliantly continuing the sacred legacy, honoring the worthy and rewarding merit, reviving extinguished lines and restoring those that had been cut off.
units.literal: Your Majesty upholds heaven's mandate, clearly opens the holy succession, honors the worthy and displays merit, revives the extinguished and continues the broken.

units.zh: 續蕭文終之後於酂，褒厲群臣平津侯等。
units.en: You have continued the line of Xiao He, the Marquis Wenzhong, at Zan, and rewarded and encouraged ministers such as the Marquis of Pingjin.
units.literal: Continues the line of Xiao Wen Zhong at Zan, rewards and encourages ministers like Pingjin Marquis and others.

units.zh: 昭六親之序，明天施之屬，使諸侯王封君得推私恩分子弟戶邑，錫號尊建百有餘國。
units.en: You have clarified the proper order of the six degrees of kinship, made manifest the relationships bestowed by Heaven's grace, and allowed feudal kings and enfeoffed lords to extend their personal favor by sharing household and township revenues with their sons and younger brothers, bestowing titles and honorably establishing over a hundred states.
units.literal: Illuminates the order of the six relatives, makes clear the relationships of heaven's grace, causes feudal kings and enfeoffed lords to extend private benevolence to divide household and townships to younger brothers and sons, bestow titles and honorably establish over one hundred countries.

units.zh: 而家皇子為列侯，則尊卑相踰，列位失序，不可以垂統於萬世。
units.en: Yet if the imperial princes were made mere marquises, then the distinction between high and low would be violated, and the proper order of ranks would be lost. It would be impossible to transmit a lasting system to all future generations.
units.literal: Yet to make the imperial sons marquises, then noble and base are confused, positions lose order, cannot be passed down to ten thousand generations.

units.zh: 臣請立臣閎、臣旦、臣胥為諸侯王。」
units.en: We, your servants, request that the princes Hong, Dan, and Xu be established as feudal kings."
units.literal: Subjects request to establish subjects Hong, Dan, Xu as feudal kings.'

units.zh: 三月丙子，奏未央宮。
units.en: On the bingzi day of the third month, this was presented at Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: Third month, day bing-zi, memorialized at Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 制曰：「康叔親屬有十而獨尊者，褒有德也。
units.en: The imperial edict read: "Among Kang Shu's ten kinsmen, he alone was singled out for honor because this was to reward virtue.
units.literal: Imperial command: 'Among Kang Shu's ten kinsmen, he alone was honored because he possessed virtue.

units.zh: 周公祭天命郊，故魯有白牡、騂剛之牲。
units.en: The Duke of Zhou performed the sacrifice to Heaven at the suburban altar, and for this reason the state of Lu was granted the privilege of using white bulls and red sacrificial animals.
units.literal: The Duke of Zhou sacrificed to heaven at the suburban altar, thus Lu had white male and red strong sacrificial animals.

units.zh: 群公不毛，賢不肖差也。
units.en: The other lords received no such special offerings—this was the distinction drawn between the worthy and the unworthy.
units.literal: The other lords did not use unplucked sacrificial animals, distinguishing the worthy from the unworthy.

units.zh: 『高山仰之，景行向之』，朕甚慕焉。
units.en: 'Lofty mountains are gazed up at; exemplary conduct is emulated'—I deeply admire these sentiments.
units.literal: 'High mountains are looked up to, brilliant conduct is followed', I greatly admire this.

units.zh: 所以抑未成，家以列侯可。」
units.en: For this reason I hold back those who are not yet mature—establishing them as marquises will suffice."
units.literal: Therefore, I suppress the immature, establishing them as marquises is acceptable.'

units.zh: 四月戊寅，奏未央宮。
units.en: On the wuyin day of the fourth month, a memorial was presented at Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: Fourth month, day wu-yin, memorialized at Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 「丞相臣青翟、御史大夫臣湯昧死言：臣青翟等與列侯、吏二千石、諫大夫、博士臣慶等議：昧死奏請立皇子為諸侯王。
units.en: "The Chancellor Qing Di and the Grandee Secretary Tang, at the risk of death, state: We, your servants Qing Di and the others, together with the marquises, officials of the two-thousand-shi rank, Remonstrant Officials, and the Erudites including Qing, have deliberated and at the risk of death submit the following memorial requesting that the imperial princes be established as feudal kings.
units.literal: 'Chancellor subject Qing Di, Censor-in-Chief subject Tang risking death speak: Subjects Qing Di and others with marquises, officials of two thousand shi, remonstrance officials, erudites subject Qing and others discuss: Risking death memorialize requesting to establish imperial sons as feudal kings.

units.zh: 制曰：『康叔親屬有十而獨尊者，褒有德也。
units.en: The imperial edict read: 'Among Kang Shu's ten kinsmen, he alone was singled out for honor because he was recognized for his virtue.
units.literal: Imperial command: 'Among Kang Shu's ten kinsmen, he alone was honored because he possessed virtue.

units.zh: 周公祭天命郊，故魯有白牡、騂剛之牲。
units.en: The Duke of Zhou performed the sacrifice to Heaven at the suburban altar, and for this reason the state of Lu was granted the privilege of using white bulls and red sacrificial animals.
units.literal: The Duke of Zhou sacrificed to heaven at the suburban altar, thus Lu had white male and red strong sacrificial animals.

units.zh: 群公不毛，賢不肖差也。
units.en: The other lords received no such special offerings—this was how the worthy were distinguished from the unworthy.
units.literal: The other lords did not use unplucked sacrificial animals, distinguishing the worthy from the unworthy.

units.zh: 「高山仰之，景行向之」，朕甚慕焉。
units.en: "Lofty mountains are gazed up at; exemplary conduct is emulated"—I deeply admire these sentiments.
units.literal: 'High mountains are looked up to, brilliant conduct is followed', I greatly admire this.

units.zh: 所以抑未成，家以列侯可。』
units.en: For this reason I hold back those who are not yet mature—establishing them as marquises will suffice.'
units.literal: Therefore, I suppress the immature, establishing them as marquises is acceptable.

units.zh: 臣青翟、臣湯、博士臣將行等伏聞康叔親屬有十，武王繼體，周公輔成王，其八人皆以祖考之尊建為大國。
units.en: We, your servants Qing Di, Tang, and the Erudite Jiang Xing, among others, have heard that among Kang Shu's ten kinsmen, King Wu succeeded to the throne and the Duke of Zhou assisted King Cheng, while the other eight were all established as lords of great states by virtue of their ancestors' eminence.
units.literal: Subjects Qing Di, Tang, Erudite subject Jiang Xing and others have heard that Kang Shu had ten relatives, King Wu succeeded to the throne, Duke of Zhou assisted King Cheng, eight of them were established as great states by the honor of their ancestors.

units.zh: 康叔之年幼，周公在三公之位，而伯禽據國於魯，蓋爵命之時，未至成人。
units.en: Kang Shu was young in years, and the Duke of Zhou held the position of one of the Three Dukes, while Bo Qin governed the state of Lu—at the time they received their titles and mandates, they had not yet reached adulthood.
units.literal: Kang Shu was young in years, Duke of Zhou held the position of one of the three dukes, yet Bo Qin held the state at Lu, probably at the time of receiving the title, they had not yet reached adulthood.

units.zh: 康叔後捍祿父之難，伯禽殄淮夷之亂。
units.en: Later, Kang Shu defended against the rebellion of Lu Fu, and Bo Qin suppressed the uprising of the Huai barbarians.
units.literal: Later Kang Shu defended against the disaster of Lu Fu, Bo Qin extinguished the rebellion of the Huai Yi.

units.zh: 昔五帝異制，周爵五等，春秋三等，皆因時而序尊卑。
units.en: In ancient times the Five Emperors each had different systems; the Zhou dynasty employed five ranks of nobility, while the Spring and Autumn period had three—all arranged the hierarchy of high and low according to the needs of their time.
units.literal: In ancient times the Five Emperors had different systems, Zhou had five ranks, Spring and Autumn had three ranks, all ordered noble and base according to the times.

units.zh: 高皇帝撥亂世反諸正，昭至德，定海內，封建諸侯，爵位二等。
units.en: Emperor Gao rescued the world from chaos and restored proper order, displayed supreme virtue, pacified the realm within the seas, and invested feudal lords with two ranks of nobility.
units.literal: Gao Emperor brought order to the chaotic world and returned to correctness, displayed supreme virtue, pacified within the seas, enfeoffed feudal lords, with two ranks of nobility.

units.zh: 皇子或在繦緥而立為諸侯王，奉承天子，為萬世法則，不可易。
units.en: Imperial princes were sometimes made feudal kings while still in swaddling clothes, to serve and uphold the Son of Heaven—this has been the model for all ages and cannot be changed.
units.literal: Imperial sons sometimes were established as feudal kings while still in swaddling clothes, supporting the Son of Heaven, as a model for ten thousand generations, cannot be changed.

units.zh: 陛下躬親仁義，體行聖德，表裏文武。
units.en: Your Majesty personally practices benevolence and righteousness, embodies and enacts sacred virtue, and unites the civil and martial arts in both outward deed and inner principle.
units.literal: Your Majesty personally practices benevolence and righteousness, embodies and practices holy virtue, both inside and outside civil and martial.

units.zh: 顯慈孝之行，廣賢能之路。
units.en: You have made manifest the conduct of compassion and filial devotion, and broadened the path for the worthy and the able.
units.literal: Displays the conduct of filial piety, broadens the path for the worthy and able.

units.zh: 內褒有德，外討彊暴。
units.en: At home, you reward the virtuous, and abroad you campaign against the strong and violent.
units.literal: Within praising virtue, without attacking the strong and violent.

units.zh: 極臨北海，西（湊）［溱］月氏，匈奴、西域，舉國奉師。
units.en: Your reach extends to the Northern Sea, westward to the Yuezhi; the Xiongnu and the Western Regions have all committed their entire realms to support our armies.
units.literal: Reached the Northern Sea, west to the Yuezhi, Xiongnu and Western Regions, the entire state supports the army.

units.zh: 輿械之費，不賦於民。
units.en: The costs of chariots and weapons have not been levied upon the common people.
units.literal: The costs of chariots and weapons, not levied from the people.

units.zh: 虛御府之藏以賞元戎，開禁倉以振貧窮，減戍卒之半。
units.en: You have emptied the imperial treasury to reward the commanding officers, opened the sealed granaries to relieve the destitute, and reduced the garrison troops by half.
units.literal: Emptied the imperial storehouse to reward the chief warriors, opened forbidden granaries to relieve the poor, reduced garrison troops by half.

units.zh: 百蠻之君，靡不鄉風，承流稱意。
units.en: The lords of the hundred barbarian tribes have all turned toward your influence, accepting your civilizing current and expressing their satisfaction.
units.literal: The rulers of the hundred barbarian tribes, none do not face the wind, following the current and fulfilling intentions.

units.zh: 遠方殊俗，重譯而朝，澤及方外。
units.en: Peoples of distant lands with alien customs come to court through layers of interpreters, and your benevolence extends beyond the borders.
units.literal: Distant regions with different customs come to court through multiple translations, benevolence extends beyond the borders.

units.zh: 故珍獸至，嘉穀興，天應甚彰。
units.en: Thus, rare beasts have appeared, auspicious grains have flourished, and Heaven's response has been made abundantly clear.
units.literal: Thus, precious beasts arrive, auspicious grains flourish, heaven's response is very clear.

units.zh: 今諸侯支子封至諸侯王，而家皇子為列侯，臣青翟、臣湯等竊伏孰計之，皆以為尊卑失序，使天下失望，不可。
units.en: At present, even the cadet sons of feudal lords have been enfeoffed as kings, yet the imperial princes would be made mere marquises. We, your servants Qing Di, Tang, and the others, have prostrated ourselves and considered this matter carefully. All of us believe that it would violate the proper order of high and low, cause the realm to lose hope, and must not be permitted.
units.literal: Now feudal lords' branch sons are enfeoffed as feudal kings, yet to make imperial sons marquises, subjects Qing Di, Tang and others secretly and prostrate consider it, all think noble and base lose order, causing the world to lose hope, cannot.

units.zh: 臣請立臣閎、臣旦、臣胥為諸侯王。」
units.en: We, your servants, request that the princes Hong, Dan, and Xu be established as feudal kings."
units.literal: Subjects request to establish subjects Hong, Dan, Xu as feudal kings.'

units.zh: 四月癸未，奏未央宮，留中不下。
units.en: On the guiwei day of the fourth month, the memorial was presented at Weiyang Palace, but it was retained within the palace and not forwarded.
units.literal: Fourth month, day gui-wei, memorialized at Weiyang Palace, kept in the palace not sent down.

units.zh: 「丞相臣青翟、太仆臣賀、行御史大夫事太常臣充、太子少傅臣安行宗正事昧死言：臣青翟等前奏大司馬臣去病上疏言，皇子未有號位，臣謹與御史大夫臣湯、中二千石、二千石、諫大夫、博士臣慶等昧死請立皇子臣閎等為諸侯王。
units.en: "The Chancellor Qing Di, the Grand Coachman He, the Grand Master of Ceremonies Chong acting as Grandee Secretary, and An, the Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince, acting as Director of the Imperial Clan, at the risk of death state: We, your servants Qing Di and the others, previously submitted a memorial regarding the Grand Marshal Qubing's petition stating that the imperial princes have not yet been granted titles. We respectfully, together with the Grandee Secretary Tang, the officials of the central two-thousand-shi and two-thousand-shi ranks, the Remonstrant Officials, and the Erudites including Qing, at the risk of death requested that the imperial princes Hong and the others be established as feudal kings.
units.literal: 'Chancellor subject Qing Di, Grand Coachman subject He, acting as Censor-in-Chief Grand Master of Ceremonies subject Chong, Crown Prince Junior Tutor subject An acting as Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan risking death speak: Subjects Qing Di and others previously memorialized Grand Marshal subject Qubing submitted memorial saying imperial sons have no titles, subjects respectfully with Censor-in-Chief subject Tang, central two thousand shi, two thousand shi, remonstrance officials, erudites subject Qing and others risking death request to establish imperial sons subject Hong and others as feudal kings.

units.zh: 陛下讓文武，躬自切，及皇子未教。
units.en: Your Majesty has deferred both civil and martial honors, been personally frugal, and noted that the imperial princes have not yet completed their education.
units.literal: Your Majesty yields civil and martial, personally frugal, including imperial sons not educated.

units.zh: 群臣之議，儒者稱其術，或誖其心。
units.en: In the ministers' deliberations, the Confucian scholars have praised the principles involved, though some have spoken against their own convictions.
units.literal: The ministers' discussions, Confucian scholars praise their methods, some contradict their hearts.

units.zh: 陛下固辭弗許，家皇子為列侯。
units.en: Your Majesty firmly declined to permit it and proposed to establish the imperial princes as marquises.
units.literal: Your Majesty firmly declined not permitting, established imperial sons as marquises.

units.zh: 臣青翟等竊與列侯臣壽成等二十七人議，皆曰以為尊卑失序。
units.en: We, your servants Qing Di and the others, have privately deliberated with the Marquis Shou Cheng and twenty-seven other officials, and all said this would violate the proper order of high and low.
units.literal: Subjects Qing Di and others secretly with Marquis subject Shou Cheng and twenty-seven others discuss; all said this violates the proper order of high and low.

units.zh: 高皇帝建天下，為漢太祖，王子孫，廣支輔。
units.en: Emperor Gao established the realm and became the Grand Progenitor of the Han, enfeoffing his sons and grandsons to broaden the branches of support for the dynasty.
units.literal: Gao Emperor established the world, as Han Taizu, enfeoffed sons and grandsons, broadened branches as auxiliaries.

units.zh: 先帝法則弗改，所以宣至尊也。
units.en: The preceding emperors did not alter this system, thereby affirming the supreme dignity of the throne.
units.literal: Previous emperor's regulations not changed, thus to proclaim supreme honor.

units.zh: 臣請令史官擇吉日，具禮儀上，御史奏輿地圖，他皆如前故事。」
units.en: We, your servants, request that the court historians be ordered to select an auspicious day, that the ceremonial protocols be prepared and submitted, that the Imperial Censor present the maps of the territories, and that all other matters follow previous precedent."
units.literal: Subjects request to command the historians to choose an auspicious day, prepare ceremonies and submit, Censor memorializes territory maps, all else as previous precedents.'

units.zh: 制曰：「可。」
units.en: The imperial edict read: "Approved."
units.literal: Imperial command: 'Acceptable.'

units.zh: 四月丙申，奏未央宮。
units.en: On the bingshen day of the fourth month, a memorial was presented at Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: Fourth month, day bing-shen, memorialized at Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 「太仆臣賀行御史大夫事昧死言：太常臣充言卜入四月二十八日乙巳，可立諸侯王。
units.en: "The Grand Coachman He, acting as Grandee Secretary, at the risk of death states: The Grand Master of Ceremonies Chong reports that divination has determined the twenty-eighth day of the fourth month, the yisi day, to be auspicious for establishing the feudal kings.
units.literal: 'Grand Coachman subject He acting as Censor-in-Chief risking death speaks: Grand Master of Ceremonies subject Chong says the divination entered fourth month twenty-eighth day yi-si, acceptable to establish feudal kings.

units.zh: 臣昧死奏輿地圖，請所立國名。
units.en: At the risk of death, your servant presents the maps of the territories and requests the names for the states to be established.
units.literal: Subject risking death memorializes territory maps, requests the names of states to establish.

units.zh: 禮儀別奏。
units.en: The ceremonial protocols will be submitted separately.
units.literal: Ceremonies to be memorialized separately.

units.zh: 臣昧死請。」
units.en: At the risk of death, your servant makes this request."
units.literal: Subject risking death requests.'

units.zh: 制曰：「立皇子閎為齊王，旦為燕王，胥為廣陵王。」
units.en: The imperial edict read: "Establish the imperial prince Hong as King of Qi, Dan as King of Yan, and Xu as King of Guangling."
units.literal: Imperial command: 'Establish imperial son Hong as King of Qi, Dan as King of Yan, Xu as King of Guangling.'

units.zh: 四月丁酉，奏未央宮。
units.en: On the dingyou day of the fourth month, a memorial was presented at Weiyang Palace.
units.literal: Fourth month, day ding-you, memorialized at Weiyang Palace.

units.zh: 六年四月戊寅朔，癸卯，御史大夫湯下丞相，丞相下中二千石，二千石下郡太守、諸侯相，丞書從事下當用者。
units.en: In the sixth year, fourth month, on the wuyin day which was the first of the month, and on the guimao day, the Grandee Secretary Tang transmitted the edict to the Chancellor, who forwarded it to the officials of the central two-thousand-shi rank, who in turn forwarded it to the commandery governors and the chancellors of the feudal states, the official documents being distributed to all those who needed to act upon them.
units.literal: In the fourth month of year 6, day wu-yin first day, day gui-mao, Censor-in-Chief Tang sent to Chancellor, Chancellor sent to central two thousand shi, two thousand shi sent to commandery governors and feudal chancellors, chancellor documents sent to those who should use them.

units.zh: 如律令。
units.en: To be executed in accordance with the laws and statutes.
units.literal: As per regulations and commands.

units.zh: 「維六年四月乙巳，皇帝使御史大夫湯廟立子閎為齊王。
units.en: "In the sixth year, fourth month, on the yisi day, the Emperor sent the Grandee Secretary Tang to the ancestral temple to invest his son Hong as King of Qi.
units.literal: 'In the fourth month of year 6, day yi-si, the Emperor sent Censor-in-Chief Tang to establish son Hong as King of Qi in the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 曰：於戲，小子閎，受茲青社！
units.en: He proclaimed: Alas, my young son Hong, receive this Altar of the Blue Earth!
units.literal: Saying: Ah, young son Hong, receive this blue altar!

units.zh: 朕承祖考，維稽古建爾國家，封于東土，世為漢藩輔。
units.en: I, inheriting the legacy of my ancestors, have looked to the precedents of antiquity to establish your state. You are enfeoffed in the eastern lands and shall serve as a bulwark and support for the Han dynasty through all generations.
units.literal: I succeed the ancestors, examining antiquity establish your state, enfeoff in the eastern lands, generation after generation as Han's border auxiliary.

units.zh: 於戲念哉！
units.en: Alas, keep this in mind!
units.literal: Ah, remember this!

units.zh: 抱朕之詔，惟命不于常。
units.en: Cherish this edict of mine and remember that the mandate of Heaven is not constant.
units.literal: Cherish my command, the mandate is not constant.

units.zh: 人之好德，克明顯光。
units.en: Those who love virtue can shine with a bright and brilliant light.
units.literal: People who love virtue can clearly shine brightly.

units.zh: 義之不圖，俾君子怠。
units.en: When righteousness is not pursued, even the worthy become complacent.
units.literal: Righteousness not planned for, causes the worthy to be indolent.

units.zh: 悉爾心，允執其中，天祿永終。
units.en: Devote your whole heart, faithfully hold to the Mean, and Heaven's blessings will endure forever.
units.literal: Devote your whole heart, faithfully hold to the center; Heaven's blessings will endure to the end.

units.zh: 厥有愆不臧，乃凶于而國，害于爾躬。
units.en: Should there be transgressions or wrongdoing, disaster will befall your state and harm will come to your person.
units.literal: If there are faults not good, then disaster to your state, harm to your person.

units.zh: 於戲，保國艾民，可不敬與！
units.en: Alas, to protect the state and cherish the people—can you afford not to be reverent!
units.literal: Ah, protect the state and cherish the people, can you not be respectful!

units.zh: 王其戒之。」
units.en: Let the King take heed of this."
units.literal: King, take heed of this.'

units.zh: 右齊王策。
units.en: The above is the charter for the King of Qi.
units.literal: Above is King of Qi's charter.

units.zh: 「維六年四月乙巳，皇帝使御史大夫湯廟立子旦為燕王。
units.en: "In the sixth year, fourth month, on the yisi day, the Emperor sent the Grandee Secretary Tang to the ancestral temple to invest his son Dan as King of Yan.
units.literal: 'In the fourth month of year 6, day yi-si, the Emperor sent Censor-in-Chief Tang to establish son Dan as King of Yan in the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 曰：於戲，小子旦，受茲玄社！
units.en: He proclaimed: Alas, my young son Dan, receive this Altar of the Black Earth!
units.literal: Saying: Ah, young son Dan, receive this black altar!

units.zh: 朕承祖考，維稽古，建爾國家，封于北土，世為漢藩輔。
units.en: I, inheriting the legacy of my ancestors and looking to the precedents of antiquity, have established your state. You are enfeoffed in the northern lands and shall serve as a bulwark and support for the Han dynasty through all generations.
units.literal: I succeed the ancestors, examining antiquity establish your state, enfeoff in the northern lands, generation after generation as Han's border auxiliary.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Ah!

units.zh: 葷粥氏虐老獸心，侵犯寇盜，加以姦巧邊萌。
units.en: The Xiongnu are cruel to the aged and beast-hearted, invading and plundering as bandits and thieves, and moreover they deal treacherously with the border settlements.
units.literal: The Hun You clan cruel aged beast heart, invading as bandits and thieves, moreover treacherous at the border settlements.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Ah!

units.zh: 朕命將率徂征厥罪，萬夫長，千夫長，三十有二君皆來，降期奔師。
units.en: I commanded my generals to march forth and punish their crimes; leaders of ten thousand, leaders of a thousand, and thirty-two chieftains all came forth, surrendering at the appointed time and rallying to our forces.
units.literal: I commanded generals to go punish their crimes; ten-thousand-man leaders, thousand-man leaders, and thirty-two lords all came, surrendering at the appointed time and fleeing to our forces.

units.zh: 葷粥徙域，北州以綏。
units.en: The Xiongnu withdrew from their lands, and the northern provinces were thereby pacified.
units.literal: Hun You moved their territory, northern provinces thus pacified.

units.zh: 悉爾心，毋作怨，毋卹德，毋乃廢備。
units.en: Devote your whole heart to this charge: do not stir up resentment, do not turn from virtue, and do not abandon your defenses.
units.literal: Devote your whole heart; do not stir up resentment, do not turn from virtue, and do not neglect your preparations.

units.zh: 非教士不得從徵。
units.en: Those who have not been trained in proper conduct may not be taken on military campaigns.
units.literal: Non-educated men may not follow the expedition.

units.zh: 於戲，保國艾民，可不敬與！
units.en: Alas, to protect the state and cherish the people—can you afford not to be reverent!
units.literal: Ah, protect the state and cherish the people, can you not be respectful!

units.zh: 王其戒之。」
units.en: Let the King take heed of this."
units.literal: King, take heed of this.'

units.zh: 右燕王策。
units.en: The above is the charter for the King of Yan.
units.literal: Above is King of Yan's charter.

units.zh: 「維六年四月乙巳，皇帝使御史大夫湯廟立子胥為廣陵王。
units.en: "In the sixth year, fourth month, on the yisi day, the Emperor sent the Grandee Secretary Tang to the ancestral temple to invest his son Xu as King of Guangling.
units.literal: 'In the fourth month of year 6, day yi-si, the Emperor sent Censor-in-Chief Tang to establish son Xu as King of Guangling in the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 曰：於戲，小子胥，受茲赤社！
units.en: He proclaimed: Alas, my young son Xu, receive this Altar of the Red Earth!
units.literal: Saying: Ah, young son Xu, receive this red altar!

units.zh: 朕承祖考，維稽古建爾國家，封于南土，世為漢藩輔。
units.en: I, inheriting the legacy of my ancestors and looking to the precedents of antiquity, have established your state. You are enfeoffed in the southern lands and shall serve as a bulwark and support for the Han dynasty through all generations.
units.literal: I succeed the ancestors, examining antiquity establish your state, enfeoff in the southern lands, generation after generation as Han's border auxiliary.

units.zh: 古人有言曰：『大江之南，五湖之閒，其人輕心。
units.en: The ancients had a saying: 'South of the Great River, among the Five Lakes, the people are fickle of heart.
units.literal: Ancient people have said: 'South of the great river, between the five lakes, their people are light-hearted.

units.zh: 楊州保疆，三代要服，不及以政。』
units.en: The region of Yang Province guards its borders; through the Three Dynasties it was a tributary territory that the central administration did not fully reach.'
units.literal: Yang province guards the borders, three dynasties' important territory, not reached by administration.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Ah!

units.zh: 悉爾心，戰戰兢兢，乃惠乃順，毋侗好軼，毋邇宵人，維法維則。
units.en: Devote your whole heart to this charge, trembling with caution; be benevolent and compliant. Do not be reckless or fond of excess, do not draw near to petty men, and cleave to the laws and rules.
units.literal: Use all your heart, be cautious and fearful, be benevolent and compliant, do not be ignorant and fond of excess, do not approach villains, follow law and rules.

units.zh: 《書》云：『臣不作威，不作福，靡有後羞。』
units.en: The Book of Documents says: 'Let the minister not arrogate authority, nor bestow favors on his own—then there shall be no later shame.'
units.literal: The Book says: 'Ministers do not create awe, do not create blessings, there will be no later shame.'

units.zh: 於戲，保國艾民，可不敬與！
units.en: Alas, to protect the state and cherish the people—can you afford not to be reverent!
units.literal: Ah, protect the state and cherish the people, can you not be respectful!

units.zh: 王其戒之。」
units.en: Let the King take heed of this."
units.literal: King, take heed of this.'

units.zh: 右廣陵王策。
units.en: The above is the charter for the King of Guangling.
units.literal: Above is King of Guangling's charter.

units.zh: 太史公曰：古人有言曰「愛之欲其富，親之欲其貴」。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: The ancients had a saying: "Those you love, you wish to be wealthy; those you are close to, you wish to be honored."
units.literal: The Grand Historian says: Ancient people have said 'Love them wish them rich, be close wish them noble'.

units.zh: 故王者壃土建國，封立子弟，所以褒親親，序骨肉，尊先祖，貴支體，廣同姓於天下也。
units.en: For this reason kings demarcate territories and establish states, investing their sons and younger brothers. In this way they honor their closest kin, order the bonds of flesh and blood, venerate their ancestors, exalt the collateral branches, and spread their surname throughout the realm.
units.literal: Therefore, kings pile earth and establish states, enfeoff and establish sons and younger brothers, thus to praise close relatives, order flesh and blood, honor ancestors, value branches and limbs, spread same surname throughout the world.

units.zh: 是以形勢彊而王室安。
units.en: In this way, the strategic position grows strong, and the royal house remains secure.
units.literal: Therefore, the situation is strong and the royal house secure.

units.zh: 自古至今，所由來久矣。
units.en: From antiquity down to the present, this has been the established practice for a very long time.
units.literal: From ancient times to now, what has come from this is long established.

units.zh: 非有異也，故弗論箸也。
units.en: Since there is nothing unusual about it, I have not discussed or recorded it at length.
units.literal: No difference, therefore not discussed and recorded.

units.zh: 燕齊之事，無足采者。
units.en: As for the affairs of the kingdoms of Yan and Qi, there is nothing of particular note worth recording.
units.literal: Yan and Qi matters have nothing worth collecting.

units.zh: 然封立三王，天子恭讓，群臣守義，文辭爛然，甚可觀也，是以附之世家。
units.en: However, in the investiture of the three kings, the Son of Heaven displayed exemplary modesty, the ministers upheld their principles, and the documents produced are brilliant in their literary quality and well worth reading. For this reason I have appended them to the Hereditary Houses.
units.literal: However, establishing the three kings, the Son of Heaven is respectfully modest, ministers uphold righteousness, the literary style is brilliant, very worthy of observation, therefore attached to the hereditary houses.

units.zh: 褚先生曰：臣幸得以文學為侍郎，好覽觀太史公之列傳。
units.en: Master Chu says: I was fortunate enough to serve as a Palace Attendant through my literary abilities, and I took pleasure in reading the Grand Historian's Biographies.
units.literal: Master Chu says: Subject fortunately became a literary attendant, likes to view and observe the Grand Historian's biographies.

units.zh: 傳中稱三王世家文辭可觀，求其世家終不能得。
units.en: In the Biographies it is stated that the Hereditary House of the Three Kings is noteworthy for the quality of its prose, yet when I searched for this hereditary house chapter, I could never find it.
units.literal: The biographies mention the Three Kings hereditary house literary style worthy of observation, sought its hereditary house ultimately could not obtain.

units.zh: 竊從長老好故事者取其封策書，編列其事而傳之，令後世得觀賢主之指意。
units.en: I privately obtained the enfeoffment charters from elderly scholars who were fond of historical precedents, arranged the events in order, and transmitted them, so that later generations might observe the intentions of a wise sovereign.
units.literal: Secretly from elders who love precedents took their enfeoffment charter writings, arranged and transmitted their matters, causing later generations to observe the wise ruler's intentions.

units.zh: 蓋聞孝武帝之時，同日而俱拜三子為王：封一子於齊，一子於廣陵，一子於燕。
units.en: I have heard that in the time of Emperor Xiaowu, on a single day all three of his sons were invested as kings: one was enfeoffed in Qi, one in Guangling, and one in Yan.
units.literal: I have heard that in Xiaowu Emperor's time, on the same day all three sons were appointed as kings: enfeoffed one son in Qi, one son in Guangling, one son in Yan.

units.zh: 各因子才力智能，及土地之剛柔，人民之輕重，為作策以申戒之。
units.en: For each son, according to his talents, abilities, and intelligence, and according to the character of the land—whether harsh or gentle—and the temperament of the people—whether headstrong or docile—the Emperor composed charters to earnestly admonish them.
units.literal: Each according to the son's talent strength intelligence, and the land's hardness softness, people's lightness heaviness, made charters to earnestly warn them.

units.zh: 謂王：「世為漢藩輔，保國治民，可不敬與！
units.en: He told each king: "You shall serve through all generations as a bulwark and support of the Han—to protect the state and govern the people, can you afford not to be reverent!
units.literal: Telling the kings: 'Generation after generation as Han's border auxiliaries, protect the state govern the people, can you not be respectful!

units.zh: 王其戒之。」
units.en: Let the King take heed of this."
units.literal: Kings, take heed of this.'

units.zh: 夫賢主所作，固非淺聞者所能知，非博聞彊記君子者所不能究竟其意。
units.en: What a wise sovereign composes is certainly beyond the understanding of those of shallow learning; only a gentleman of broad erudition and powerful memory can fathom its full meaning.
units.literal: What a wise ruler makes is certainly not something shallow learners can know; it is not something that gentlemen of broad learning and strong memory cannot thoroughly fathom in its intent.

units.zh: 至其次序分絕，文字之上下，簡之參差長短，皆有意，人莫之能知。
units.en: Even the ordering, divisions, and breaks, the arrangement of the text, and the varying lengths of the bamboo slips—all carry meaning that ordinary people cannot discern.
units.literal: Even the sequence divisions and breaks, the up and down of writing, the uneven lengths of slips, all have meaning, people cannot know it.

units.zh: 謹論次其真草詔書，編于左方。
units.en: I have respectfully arranged the authentic draft edicts in proper order, compiled on the left.
units.literal: Respectfully arranged their true draft edicts, compiled on the left side.

units.zh: 令覽者自通其意而解說之。
units.en: I leave it to the reader to work out the meaning and interpret it for himself.
units.literal: Cause viewers to connect their meaning and explain it themselves.

units.zh: 王夫人者，趙人也，與衛夫人并幸武帝，而生子閎。
units.en: Lady Wang was a native of Zhao. She and Lady Wei were both favored by Emperor Wu, and she bore him a son named Hong.
units.literal: Lady Wang was a woman of Zhao, together with Lady Wei both favored by Wudi, and bore son Hong.

units.zh: 閎且立為王時，其母病，武帝自臨問之。
units.en: When Hong was about to be invested as king, his mother fell ill, and Emperor Wu personally went to visit her.
units.literal: When Hong was about to be established as king, his mother was ill, Wudi personally visited and asked her.

units.zh: 曰：「子當為王，欲安所置之？」
units.en: He asked: "Your son is to be made a king—where would you like him to be placed?"
units.literal: Saying: 'Son should become king, where do you wish to place him?'

units.zh: 王夫人曰：「陛下在，妾又何等可言者。」
units.en: Lady Wang replied: "While Your Majesty is alive, what should I possibly have to say?"
units.literal: Lady Wang said: 'Your Majesty is alive, what else can subject wife say.'

units.zh: 帝曰：「雖然，意所欲，欲於何所王之？」
units.en: The Emperor said: "Even so, what is your wish? In what place would you like him to be made king?"
units.literal: The emperor said: 'Although this, what is your intention, in what place do you wish to make him king?'

units.zh: 王夫人曰：「願置之雒陽。」
units.en: Lady Wang said: "I would wish to have him placed in Luoyang."
units.literal: Lady Wang said: 'Wish to place him in Luoyang.'

units.zh: 武帝曰：「雒陽有武庫敖倉，天下衝阸，漢國之大都也。
units.en: Emperor Wu said: "Luoyang has the imperial armory and the Ao granary; it is the crossroads of the realm and the great capital of the Han.
units.literal: Wudi said: 'Luoyang has the armory and Ao granary, world's thoroughfare, Han's great capital.

units.zh: 先帝以來，無子王於雒陽者。
units.en: Since the time of the former emperors, no prince has ever been made king at Luoyang.
units.literal: From previous emperors, no son has been made king in Luoyang.

units.zh: 去雒陽，餘盡可。」
units.en: Apart from Luoyang, all other places are acceptable."
units.literal: Except Luoyang, the rest are all acceptable.'

units.zh: 王夫人不應。
units.en: Lady Wang made no reply.
units.literal: Lady Wang did not respond.

units.zh: 武帝曰：「關東之國無大於齊者。
units.en: Emperor Wu said: "Among the states east of the passes, none is greater than Qi.
units.literal: Wudi said: 'Among the Guandong states none is greater than Qi.

units.zh: 齊東負海而城郭大，古時獨臨菑中十萬戶，天下膏腴地莫盛於齊者矣。」
units.en: Qi has the sea at its eastern back and great city walls; in ancient times, the capital Linzi alone contained a hundred thousand households. Of all the fertile lands in the realm, none surpasses Qi."
units.literal: Qi east faces the sea with great city walls, in ancient times Linzi alone had 100,000 households, the world's fertile lands none more prosperous than Qi.'

units.zh: 王夫人以手擊頭，謝曰：「幸甚。」
units.en: Lady Wang struck her forehead with her hand in gratitude and said: "How fortunate!"
units.literal: Lady Wang struck her head with her hand, thanked saying: 'Very fortunate.'

units.zh: 王夫人死而帝痛之，使使者拜之曰：「皇帝謹使使太中大夫明奉璧一，賜夫人為齊王太后。」
units.en: When Lady Wang died, the Emperor grieved for her deeply and sent an envoy to make a posthumous proclamation: "The Emperor respectfully dispatches the Grand Palace Attendant Ming to present one jade bi disk and bestows upon the Lady the title of Queen Dowager of the King of Qi."
units.literal: Lady Wang died and the emperor grieved for her, sent envoys to confer saying: 'The Emperor respectfully sends Grand Palace Attendant Ming to present one jade disk, granting Lady to be Queen Mother of King of Qi.'

units.zh: 子閎王齊，年少，無有子，立，不幸早死，國絕，為郡。
units.en: Her son Hong reigned as King of Qi, but he was young and had no sons. After his investiture he unfortunately died young, the kingdom was extinguished, and its territory was converted into a commandery.
units.literal: Son Hong ruled Qi, young, had no sons, established, unfortunately died early, kingdom extinguished, became a commandery.

units.zh: 天下稱齊不宜王云。
units.en: People throughout the realm said that Qi was not a suitable place for a king.
units.literal: The world says Qi is not suitable for kings.

units.zh: 所謂「受此土」者，諸侯王始封者必受土於天子之社，歸立之以為國社，以歲時祠之。
units.en: The expression "receive this earth" means that a feudal king, upon his initial investiture, must receive soil from the Son of Heaven's altar, bring it home and establish it as the state altar, and offer sacrifices there according to the seasons.
units.literal: What is called 'receive this earth' means feudal kings first enfeoffed must receive earth at the Son of Heaven's altar, return and establish it as the state altar, sacrifice to it seasonally.

units.zh: 春秋大傳曰：「天子之國有泰社。
units.en: The Grand Commentary on the Spring and Autumn Annals states: "The Son of Heaven's state has the Grand Altar of Soil.
units.literal: Spring and Autumn Grand Tradition says: 'The Son of Heaven's state has the Great Altar.

units.zh: 東方青，南方赤，西方白，北方黑，上方黃。」
units.en: The east is blue, the south is red, the west is white, the north is black, and the center is yellow."
units.literal: East blue, south red, west white, north black, above yellow.'

units.zh: 故將封於東方者取青土，封於南方者取赤土，封於西方者取白土，封於北方者取黑土，封於上方者取黃土。
units.en: Therefore, those to be enfeoffed in the east take blue earth, those in the south take red earth, those in the west take white earth, those in the north take black earth, and those in the center take yellow earth.
units.literal: Therefore, those to be enfeoffed in the east take blue earth, enfeoffed in the south take red earth, enfeoffed in the west take white earth, enfeoffed in the north take black earth, enfeoffed above take yellow earth.

units.zh: 各取其色物，裹以白茅，封以為社。
units.en: Each takes the earth of the appropriate color, wraps it in white rushes, and establishes it as the altar of soil.
units.literal: Each takes their color objects, wrapped in white thatch, enfeoff as altar.

units.zh: 此始受封於天子者也。
units.en: This is the ceremony for those first receiving their investiture from the Son of Heaven.
units.literal: This is those first receiving enfeoffment from the Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 此之為主土。
units.en: This is what is meant by the sovereign earth.
units.literal: This is called ruling earth.

units.zh: 主土者，立社而奉之也。
units.en: The sovereign earth means establishing the altar of soil and offering sacrifices to it.
units.literal: Ruling earth means establishing altar and honoring it.

units.zh: 「朕承祖考」，祖者先也，考者父也。
units.en: "I inherit the legacy of my ancestors": the word for ancestors refers to one's forebears, and the word for fathers refers to one's father.
units.literal: 'I succeed ancestors and fathers', ancestors mean predecessors, fathers mean fathers.

units.zh: 「維稽古」，維者度也，念也，稽者當也，當順古之道也。
units.en: "Looking to the precedents of antiquity": the character meaning "to look" implies deliberation and reflection, while the character meaning "to examine" implies conformity—that is, conforming to the ways of the ancients.
units.literal: 'Examining antiquity', examining means measuring, thinking, examining means matching, matching to follow ancient ways.

units.zh: 齊地多變詐，不習於禮義，故戒之曰「恭朕之詔，唯命不可為常。
units.en: The land of Qi is prone to scheming and deception, its people unaccustomed to ritual propriety and righteousness. Therefore, the admonishment states: "Revere this edict of mine. Remember that the mandate is never constant.
units.literal: Qi land has much deceit and deception, not accustomed to rites and righteousness, therefore warned saying 'Cherish my edict, the mandate cannot be constant.

units.zh: 人之好德，能明顯光。
units.en: Those who love virtue can shine with a bright and brilliant light.
units.literal: People who love virtue can clearly shine brightly.

units.zh: 不圖於義，使君子怠慢。
units.en: When righteousness is not pursued, even the worthy become negligent.
units.literal: Not planning for righteousness causes the worthy to be indolent.

units.zh: 悉若心，信執其中，天祿長終。
units.en: Devote your whole heart, faithfully hold to the Mean, and Heaven's blessings will endure to the end.
units.literal: Devote your whole heart, faithfully hold to the center; Heaven's blessings will endure to the end.

units.zh: 有過不善，乃凶于而國，而害于若身」。
units.en: Should there be transgressions or wrongdoing, disaster will befall your state and harm will come to your person."
units.literal: If there are faults not good, then disaster to your state, harm to your person.'

units.zh: 齊王之國，左右維持以禮義，不幸中年早夭。
units.en: The King of Qi governed his state with those around him upholding ritual propriety and righteousness, but unfortunately he died young in his prime.
units.literal: The King of Qi's rule, left and right maintained with rites and righteousness, unfortunately died young in middle age.

units.zh: 然全身無過，如其策意。
units.en: Nevertheless, he preserved himself without fault, just as the charter had intended.
units.literal: However, kept body without faults, as the charter intended.

units.zh: 傳曰「青采出於藍，而質青於藍」者，教使然也。
units.en: The tradition that says "blue dye comes from the indigo plant, yet is bluer than indigo itself" speaks to the transformative power of proper instruction.
units.literal: The tradition says 'Blue comes from indigo but is bluer than indigo', teaching makes it so.

units.zh: 遠哉賢主，昭然獨見：誡齊王以慎內；
units.en: How far-sighted was the wise sovereign, seeing clearly what no one else perceived! He admonished the King of Qi to be prudent in internal affairs;
units.literal: Far indeed the wise ruler, clearly seeing alone: warned King of Qi to be careful within;

units.zh: 誡燕王以無作怨，無修德；
units.en: he admonished the King of Yan not to stir up resentment and not to cultivate virtue;
units.literal: warned the King of Yan not to create resentment, not to cultivate virtue;

units.zh: 誡廣陵王以慎外，無作威與福。
units.en: and he admonished the King of Guangling to be prudent in external affairs and not to arrogate authority or bestow favors.
units.literal: warned King of Guangling to be careful without, not to create awe and blessings.

units.zh: 夫廣陵在吳越之地，其民精而輕，故誡之曰「江湖之閒，其人輕心。
units.en: Guangling lies in the lands of Wu and Yue, whose people are clever but fickle. Therefore, the admonishment states: "Among the rivers and lakes, the people are inconstant of heart.
units.literal: Now Guangling is in Wu and Yue lands, their people are clever and light, therefore warned saying 'Between the rivers and lakes, their people are light-hearted.

units.zh: 楊州葆疆，三代之時，迫要使從中國俗服，不大及以政教，以意御之而已。
units.en: Yang Province guarded its borders; in the time of the Three Dynasties it was compelled to adopt the customs and attire of the Central States, but the central government did not fully extend its administration and instruction there, governing it in principle only.
units.literal: Yang province guards borders, in Three Dynasties time, compelled to make follow Central States customs and clothing, not greatly reaching with governance and teaching, only control with intention.

units.zh: 無侗好佚，無邇宵人，維法是則。
units.en: Do not be reckless or fond of idleness, do not draw near to petty men, and always take the law as your guide.
units.literal: Do not be ignorant fond of leisure, do not approach villains, follow law as rule.

units.zh: 無長好佚樂馳騁弋獵淫康，而近小人。
units.en: Do not develop a lasting fondness for idle pleasures, racing, hunting, and indulgence, or draw close to petty men.
units.literal: Do not long love leisure pleasure racing hunting indulgence, and approach small men.

units.zh: 常念法度，則無羞辱矣」。
units.en: Always keep the laws and standards in mind, and you will be free of shame and disgrace."
units.literal: Always think of law and standards, then there will be no shame and humiliation.'

units.zh: 三江、五湖有魚鹽之利，銅山之富，天下所仰。
units.en: The Three Rivers and Five Lakes yield the profits of fish and salt, and the copper mountains produce great wealth—resources upon which the entire realm depends.
units.literal: The three rivers and five lakes have fish and salt profits, copper mountain wealth, what the world looks up to.

units.zh: 故誡之曰「臣不作福」者，勿使行財幣，厚賞賜，以立聲譽，為四方所歸也。
units.en: Therefore, the admonishment "let the minister not bestow favors" means that he should not distribute wealth and gifts freely or lavish rewards in order to build a reputation and become a rallying point for people from all quarters.
units.literal: Therefore, warned saying 'ministers do not create blessings' means do not let them circulate wealth and currency, give thick rewards, to establish reputation, become what four directions return to.

units.zh: 又曰「臣不作威」者，勿使因輕以倍義也。
units.en: The further admonishment "let the minister not arrogate authority" means that he should not exploit the people's fickleness to forsake righteousness.
units.literal: Also saying 'ministers do not create awe' means do not let them because of lightness betray righteousness.

units.zh: 會孝武帝崩，孝昭帝初立，先朝廣陵王胥，厚賞賜金錢財幣，直三千餘萬，益地百里，邑萬戶。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaowu passed away and Emperor Xiaozhao first ascended the throne, he summoned the King of Guangling, Xu, to court and lavished upon him rewards of gold, money, and other valuables worth over thirty million, adding a hundred li to his territory and ten thousand households to his domain.
units.literal: When Xiaowu Emperor passed away, Xiao Zhao Emperor first established, first summoned King Xu of Guangling, thickly rewarded gold money wealth currency, worth over 30 million, increased land 100 li, townships 10,000 households.

units.zh: 會昭帝崩，宣帝初立，緣恩行義，以本始元年中，裂漢地，盡以封廣陵王胥四子：一子為朝陽侯；
units.en: When Emperor Zhao passed away and Emperor Xuan first ascended the throne, extending favor and practicing righteousness, in the middle of the first year of the Benshi era he carved out Han territory and enfeoffed all four sons of the King of Guangling, Xu: one son was made Marquis of Chaoyang;
units.literal: When Zhao Emperor passed away, Xuan Emperor first established, following benevolence practicing righteousness, in Benshi first year middle, split Han territory, all to enfeoff King Xu of Guangling's four sons: one son as Chaoyang Marquis;

units.zh: 一子為平曲侯；
units.en: one son was made Marquis of Pingqu;
units.literal: one son as Pingqu Marquis;

units.zh: 一子為南利侯；
units.en: one son was made Marquis of Nanli;
units.literal: one son as Nanli Marquis;

units.zh: 最愛少子弘，立以為高密王。
units.en: and his most beloved youngest son, Hong, was established as King of Gaomi.
units.literal: most loved youngest son Hong, established as King of Gaomi.

units.zh: 其後胥果作威福，通楚王使者。
units.en: Subsequently, Xu did indeed arrogate authority and bestow favors, and he began communicating with envoys from the King of Chu.
units.literal: Afterwards Xu indeed created awe and blessings, communicated with King of Chu's envoys.

units.zh: 楚王宣言曰：「我先元王，高帝少弟也，封三十二城。
units.en: The King of Chu openly proclaimed: "My ancestor, King Yuan, was the younger brother of Emperor Gao and was enfeoffed with thirty-two cities.
units.literal: King of Chu openly declared: 'My ancestor King Yuan, Gao Emperor's younger brother, enfeoffed 32 cities.

units.zh: 今地邑益少，我欲與廣陵王共發兵云。
units.en: Now our territory and towns grow ever fewer. I intend to join with the King of Guangling in raising troops.
units.literal: Now land and townships increasingly few, I wish to together with the King of Guangling raise troops.

units.zh: ［立］廣陵王為上，我復王楚三十二城，如元王時。」
units.en: We shall set up the King of Guangling as the supreme ruler, and I shall once again reign over Chu with thirty-two cities, as in the days of King Yuan."
units.literal: Establish the King of Guangling as supreme, I again rule Chu 32 cities, like King Yuan time.'

units.zh: 事發覺，公卿有司請行罰誅。
units.en: When the plot was discovered, the ministers and officials requested that punishment and execution be carried out.
units.literal: Matter discovered, dukes and ministers officials requested to carry out punishment and execution.

units.zh: 天子以骨肉之故，不忍致法於胥，下詔書無治廣陵王，獨誅首惡楚王。
units.en: The Son of Heaven, out of consideration for their bond of blood, could not bear to apply the full force of the law to Xu. He issued an edict sparing the King of Guangling from prosecution and executed only the chief culprit, the King of Chu.
units.literal: Son of Heaven because of flesh and blood, could not bear to apply law to Xu, issued edict not to punish King Xu of Guangling, alone execute chief evil King of Chu.

units.zh: 傳曰「蓬生麻中，不扶自直；
units.en: The tradition says: "The fleabane growing among hemp stalks straightens itself without support;
units.literal: Tradition says 'puff growing among hemp, without support straightens itself;

units.zh: 白沙在泥中，與之皆黑」者，土地教化使之然也。
units.en: white sand in mud turns black along with it." It is the land and its civilization that make things so."
units.literal: white sand in mud, with it all black', land and civilization make it so."

units.zh: 其後胥復祝詛謀反，自殺，國除。
units.en: Later, Xu again resorted to sorcerous curses and plotted rebellion. He committed suicide, and his kingdom was abolished.
units.literal: Afterwards Xu again cursed and plotted rebellion, committed suicide, kingdom abolished.

units.zh: 燕土墝埆，北迫匈奴，其人民勇而少慮，故誡之曰「葷粥氏無有孝行而禽獸心，以竊盜侵犯邊民。
units.en: The land of Yan is rocky and barren, pressed close to the Xiongnu on the north, and its people are brave but reckless. Therefore, the admonishment states: "The Xiongnu have no sense of filial duty and are beastly in nature, plundering and invading the border settlements.
units.literal: Yan land is uneven and barren, north presses Xiongnu, their people brave but little thought, therefore warned saying 'Xiongnu clan has no filial conduct but beast heart, with theft invades border people.

units.zh: 朕詔將軍往征其罪，萬夫長，千夫長，三十有二君皆來，降旗奔師。
units.en: I commanded my generals to march forth and punish their crimes; leaders of ten thousand, leaders of a thousand, and thirty-two chieftains all came forward, lowering their banners and surrendering to our forces.
units.literal: I commanded generals to go punish their crimes, ten thousand man leaders, thousand man leaders, thirty-two lords all came, surrendered banners fled army.

units.zh: 葷粥徙域遠處，北州以安矣」。
units.en: The Xiongnu withdrew to their distant territories, and the northern provinces were thereby pacified."
units.literal: Xiongnu moved territory far away, northern provinces thus pacified.'

units.zh: 「悉若心，無作怨」者，勿使從俗以怨望也。
units.en: "Devote your whole heart, do not stir up resentment" means that he should not follow local customs in harboring grudges and resentful ambitions.
units.literal: 'Use all your heart, do not create resentment' means do not let them follow customs to resent and hope.

units.zh: 「無俷德」者，勿使（上）［王］背德也。
units.en: "Do not turn from virtue" means that the King should not turn his back on virtuous conduct.
units.literal: 'Do not go against virtue' means do not let the king turn back on virtue.

units.zh: 「無廢備」者，無乏武備，常備匈奴也。
units.en: "Do not abandon your defenses" means do not let the martial preparations lapse, but maintain constant readiness against the Xiongnu.
units.literal: 'Do not neglect preparations' means do not lack martial preparations, constantly prepare for Xiongnu.

units.zh: 「非教士不得從徵」者，言非習禮義不得在於側也。
units.en: "Those who have not been trained may not be taken on campaigns" means that those who have not been instructed in ritual propriety and righteousness may not serve at his side.
units.literal: 'Non-educated men may not follow expedition' means non-accustomed to rites and righteousness may not be at the side.

units.zh: 會武帝年老長，而太子不幸薨，未有所立，而旦使來上書，請身入宿衛於長安。
units.en: In time, Emperor Wu grew old, and the Crown Prince unfortunately died. No successor had yet been established when Dan sent a memorial requesting permission to come to Chang'an in person to serve in the palace guard.
units.literal: When Wudi grew old, and the crown prince unfortunately died, not yet established successor, yet Dan sent to submit memorial, requesting personally enter guard duty in Chang'an.

units.zh: 孝武見其書，擊地，怒曰：「生子當置之齊魯禮義之鄉，乃置之燕趙，果有爭心，不讓之端見矣。」
units.en: When Emperor Xiaowu read the memorial, he struck the ground in rage and said: "When a son is born, he should be placed in the land of Qi and Lu, where ritual propriety and righteousness prevail. Instead, I placed him in Yan and Zhao, and sure enough he has developed a contentious spirit—the first signs of insubordination are already showing."
units.literal: Xiaowu seeing his memorial, struck ground, angry saying: 'Giving birth to son should place in Qi Lu rites and righteousness lands, yet placed in Yan Zhao, indeed has contending heart, unyielding beginning appears.'

units.zh: 於是使使即斬其使者於闕下。
units.en: He then had Dan's envoy beheaded at the foot of the palace gate.
units.literal: Thus, sent envoys immediately behead his envoy at the palace gate.

units.zh: 會武帝崩，昭帝初立，旦果作怨而望大臣。
units.en: When Emperor Wu died and Emperor Zhao first ascended the throne, Dan did indeed nurture resentment and harbored expectations of the great ministers.
units.literal: When Wudi passed away, Zhao Emperor first established, Dan indeed created resentment and hoped from ministers.

units.zh: 自以長子當立，與齊王子劉澤等謀為叛逆，出言曰：「我安得弟在者！
units.en: Considering himself the eldest surviving son and therefore the rightful heir, he plotted rebellion with the son of a former King of Qi, Liu Ze, and others. He declared: "How can it be that I have a younger brother who still lives!
units.literal: Considering himself eldest son should establish, with Qi king's son Liu Ze and others plotted rebellion, spoke saying: 'How can I have younger brother alive!

units.zh: 今立者乃大將軍子也。」
units.en: The one now on the throne is merely the son of the Grand General."
units.literal: Now established is the Grand General's son.'

units.zh: 欲發兵。
units.en: He intended to raise troops.
units.literal: Wished to raise troops.

units.zh: 事發覺，當誅。
units.en: The plot was discovered, and by rights he should have been executed.
units.literal: Matter discovered, should be executed.

units.zh: 昭帝緣恩寬忍，抑案不揚。
units.en: Emperor Zhao, out of familial kindness and forbearance, suppressed the case and did not publicize it.
units.literal: Zhao Emperor following benevolence tolerant, suppressed case not publicized.

units.zh: 公卿使大臣請，遣宗正與太中大夫公戶滿意、御史二人，偕往使燕，風喻之。
units.en: The ministers at court petitioned for action, and the Director of the Imperial Clan was dispatched along with the Grand Palace Attendant Gong Hu Manyi and two Imperial Censors, who together traveled as envoys to Yan to admonish Dan indirectly.
units.literal: Dukes and ministers had ministers request, sent Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan and Grand Palace Attendant Gong Hu Man Yi, two censors, together go as envoys to Yan, indirectly admonish him.

units.zh: 到燕，各異日，更見責王。
units.en: When they arrived in Yan, they visited the King on different days, each in turn reproaching him.
units.literal: Arrived in Yan, each different day, alternately saw and reproached the king.

units.zh: 宗正者，主宗室諸劉屬籍，先見王，為列陳道昭帝實武帝子狀。
units.en: The Director of the Imperial Clan, who oversees the genealogical registers of all the Liu members of the imperial family, was the first to see the King. He methodically laid out the evidence that Emperor Zhao was in truth the son of Emperor Wu.
units.literal: Chamberlain for the Imperial Clan, manages imperial clan various Liu genealogy, first saw king, listed and explained Zhao Emperor truly Wudi's son situation.

units.zh: 侍御史乃復見王，責之以正法，問：「王欲發兵罪名明白，當坐之。
units.en: The Attendant Censor then visited the King in turn, confronting him with the law. He declared: "The King's intention to raise troops is a clearly established crime, and by law he should be condemned for it.
units.literal: Attendant Censor then again saw king, reproached with proper law, asked: 'King wishes to raise troops crime name clear, should condemn him.

units.zh: 漢家有正法，王犯纖介小罪過，即行法直斷耳，安能寬王。」
units.en: The House of Han has its established law: if the King commits even the slightest offense, the law is carried out and judgment delivered—how could leniency be shown to the King?"
units.literal: Han house has proper law, king commits tiny small offense, immediately carries out law straight judgment, how can pardon king.'

units.zh: 驚動以文法。
units.en: He shook and intimidated the King with the statutes and laws.
units.literal: Shocked and moved with statutes and laws.

units.zh: 王意益下，心恐。
units.en: The King's defiance crumbled further, and fear seized his heart.
units.literal: King's intent increasingly lowered, heart feared.

units.zh: 公戶滿意習於經術，最後見王，稱引古今通義，國家大禮，文章爾雅。
units.en: Gong Hu Manyi, well versed in the classics, was the last to see the King. He cited the universal principles of antiquity and the present, spoke of the great rites of the state, and his words were elegant and refined.
units.literal: Gong Hu Man Yi versed in classics, last saw king, cited ancient and modern universal principles, state great rites, writings elegant and proper.

units.zh: 謂王曰：「古者天子必內有異姓大夫，所以正骨肉也；
units.en: He addressed the King: "In ancient times, the Son of Heaven always had ministers of different surnames within the court to keep his own flesh and blood in check;
units.literal: Told king: 'Anciently Son of Heaven must have different surname officials within, thus to correct flesh and blood;

units.zh: 外有同姓大夫，所以正異族也。
units.en: and he had ministers of the same surname without to keep other clans in order.
units.literal: without have same surname officials, thus to correct different clans.

units.zh: 周公輔成王，誅其兩弟，故治。
units.en: The Duke of Zhou, in assisting King Cheng, put his own two brothers to death, and thereby brought order to the realm.
units.literal: Duke of Zhou assisted King Cheng, executed his two younger brothers, thus orderly.

units.zh: 武帝在時，尚能寬王。
units.en: When Emperor Wu was alive, he could still afford to show the King leniency.
units.literal: Wudi in his time, still could pardon king.

units.zh: 今昭帝始立，年幼，富於春秋，未臨政，委任大臣。
units.en: Now Emperor Zhao has only just ascended the throne; he is young in years, still in his youth, has not yet taken personal charge of the government, and has entrusted affairs to the ministers.
units.literal: Now Zhao Emperor first established, year young, rich in springtime, not yet administering government, entrusts ministers.

units.zh: 古者誅罰不阿親戚，故天下治。
units.en: In ancient times, executions and punishments were carried out without favoritism toward kinsmen, and thus the realm was well governed.
units.literal: Anciently executions and punishments did not favor relatives, thus world orderly.

units.zh: 方今大臣輔政，奉法直行，無敢所阿，恐不能寬王。
units.en: At present the great ministers assist in governing and apply the law without deviation; none dares to show partiality. I fear they will not be able to show the King leniency.
units.literal: Now ministers assist government, follow law straight action, none dare favor, fear cannot pardon king.

units.zh: 王可自謹，無自令身死國滅，為天下笑。」
units.en: The King should exercise the utmost caution, lest he bring about his own death and the destruction of his kingdom, making himself a laughingstock for all the realm."
units.literal: King can be careful himself, not cause body die kingdom extinguish, become world's laughter.'

units.zh: 於是燕王旦乃恐懼服罪，叩頭謝過。
units.en: At this, the King of Yan, Dan, was seized with fear and admitted his guilt, kowtowing and begging forgiveness for his offense.
units.literal: Thus, King Dan of Yan then feared and submitted to crime, kowtowed apologized for offense.

units.zh: 大臣欲和合骨肉，難傷之以法。
units.en: The great ministers wished to preserve harmony among the imperial kinsmen and found it difficult to apply the full force of the law against him.
units.literal: Ministers wished to harmonize flesh and blood, difficult to harm with law.

units.zh: 其後旦復與左將軍上官桀等謀反，宣言曰「我次太子，太子不在，我當立，大臣共抑我」云云。
units.en: Later, Dan again plotted rebellion, this time with the General of the Left, Shangguan Jie, and others. He declared: "I am next in line after the Crown Prince. Since the Crown Prince is no longer alive, I should be on the throne. The ministers are all conspiring to keep me down"—and so on.
units.literal: Afterwards Dan again with Left General Shangguan Jie and others plotted rebellion, declared 'I am next crown prince, crown prince not present, I should establish, ministers together suppress me' and so on.

units.zh: 大將軍光輔政，與公卿大臣議曰：「燕王旦不改過悔正，行惡不變。」
units.en: The Grand General Guang, who was assisting in the government, deliberated with the ministers and declared: "The King of Yan, Dan, refuses to mend his ways or repent his wrongs; he persists in evil without change."
units.literal: Grand General Guang assisted government, with dukes and ministers discussed: 'King Dan of Yan does not change error repent righteousness, practices evil unchanging.'

units.zh: 於是修法直斷，行罰誅。
units.en: Thereupon the law was applied and judgment rendered without equivocation, and punishment and execution were carried out.
units.literal: Thus, followed law straight judgment, carried out punishment execution.

units.zh: 旦自殺，國除，如其策指。
units.en: Dan committed suicide, and his kingdom was abolished—just as the investiture charter had foretold.
units.literal: Dan committed suicide, kingdom abolished, as the charter indicated.

units.zh: 有司請誅旦妻子。
units.en: The officials requested that Dan's wife and children be executed.
units.literal: Officials requested to execute Dan's wife and children.

units.zh: 孝昭以骨肉之親，不忍致法，寬赦旦妻子，免為庶人。
units.en: Emperor Xiaozhao, out of consideration for their bond of blood, could not bear to apply the full force of the law. He generously pardoned Dan's wife and children, reducing them to the status of commoners.
units.literal: Xiao Zhao because of flesh and blood closeness, could not bear to apply law, generously pardoned Dan's wife and children, demoted to commoners.

units.zh: 傳曰「蘭根與白芷，漸之滫中，君子不近，庶人不服」者，所以漸然也。
units.en: The tradition says: "Even orchid root and angelica, when steeped in foul brine, become things that the worthy will not go near and the common people will not wear"—and that is exactly how such things come to pass through gradual influence.
units.literal: Tradition says 'orchid root and angelica, soaked in brine, worthy men do not approach, common men do not wear', this is why it is so.

units.zh: 宣帝初立，推恩宣德，以本始元年中盡復封燕王旦兩子：一子為安定侯；
units.en: When Emperor Xuan first ascended the throne, he extended favor and proclaimed his virtue. In the middle of the first year of the Benshi era, he restored the enfeoffments of both of the late King Dan of Yan's sons: one was made Marquis of Anding;
units.literal: Xuan Emperor first established, extended benevolence proclaimed virtue, in Benshi first year middle all restored enfeoffment of King Dan of Yan's two sons: one son as An Ding Marquis;

units.zh: 立燕故太子建為廣陽王，以奉燕王祭祀。
units.en: and the former Crown Prince of Yan, Jian, was established as King of Guangyang, to continue the sacrifices to the kings of Yan.
units.literal: established Yan's former crown prince Jian as King of Guangyang, to carry out Yan king's sacrifices.
